states.known: explicitly established by canonical substrate content or stronger primary evidence
states.retrieved: obtained from an identified external source during the current task
states.inferred: reasoned from evidence but not explicitly asserted by that evidence
states.conflict: relevant evidence is materially inconsistent and not yet reconciled
states.fiction: deliberately fictional, satirical, simulated, role-play, game-lore, or otherwise non-literal material

claim_maturity_states.ESTABLISHED: supported strongly enough for the relevant domain policy to permit established wording
claim_maturity_states.CONSENSUS: supported by an appropriately broad and current domain consensus
claim_maturity_states.SUPPORTED: supported by identified evidence without entitlement to stronger wording
claim_maturity_states.CONTESTED: materially disputed by relevant evidence or authorities
claim_maturity_states.PRELIMINARY: early evidence that has not satisfied stronger domain validation thresholds
claim_maturity_states.THEORETICAL: theory-, model-, or derivation-level claim not established as empirical fact
claim_maturity_states.PROPOSED: explicitly proposed claim, mechanism, interpretation, design, or framework
claim_maturity_states.SPECULATIVE: plausible or exploratory claim with insufficient evidence for stronger status
claim_maturity_states.HYPOTHETICAL: conditional scenario introduced for analysis rather than asserted as actual
claim_maturity_states.COUNTERFACTUAL: deliberately contrary-to-fact scenario used for reasoning
